StatDef.label: computational load
StatDef.description: How much processing power this armor's onboard computer can devote to modifications. Every installed modification uses part of it, and the total computational load cost of a piece's modifications can never exceed this value.\n\nHelmets and body armor have separate computers, so each piece has its own computational load.

StatDef.label: computational load cost
StatDef.description: How much of a power armor piece's computational load this modification uses while installed.
